name: The Lifeboat House
reading: Misty's town is the lake's rescue service, the town that takes in whoever the water brings (docs/world-building/TOWN_CHARACTER.md gym2_town: rescue boats, a record of every arrival; prismarine and mud brick, dark oak, spruce). Her gym is now the rescue station itself, one mud-brick building on its lot with its back to the lake. In from the promenade to the arrivals hall, where the lockers and the arrivals board are; down the one step in the cistern wall to the race, a still canal wall to wall that is waded and swum; across it, three mouths alike, and only the west one has light in it; through that one into the ledger gallery, where every arrival is shelved; down the slipway into the boat house, kept as the owner liked it: the prismarine quay, the launch channel along the south wall with the boat still lying in it, buoys and the lifeline, the lifebuoy on the end wall, and Misty on the lookout deck at the far end. Out past her over the gangway and through the iron door onto the shore, or back the way you came.
